│ Catchment:                      │                         │ Catchment:                      │
│ • Ernakulam & Thrissur          │                         │ • Panruti, Melmampattu,         │

└─────────────────────────────────┘                         └─────────────────────────────────┘
Strategic Role: India's commercial hub for innovative jackfruit engineering, vacuum frying, retort packaging, and clinical flour commercialization.
Catchment Areas: Homestead agroforestry and commercial plantations across Ernakulam (Muvattupuzha, Kothamangalam), Idukki (Thodupuzha), Wayanad, Thrissur, and Kottayam.
Strategic Role: The highest-density commercial monocropping and consolidation belt in South Asia. Operates daily round-the-clock manual bulbing yards, supplying minimally processed fresh flakes and whole green fruits to South Indian food factories.
Catchment Areas: Specialized mono-cropped orchards across Panruti, Melmampattu, Silambinathanpet, and surrounding tracts of Cuddalore and Villupuram.
Strategic Role: Elite clonal multiplication, seed processing, and emerging freeze-drying/dehydration lines.
Key Facilities: Incubation facilities at UAS GKVK Bengaluru, KVK Hirehalli (Tumakuru), and private dehydration units along the Mangaluru–Udupi coastal strip.
Catchment Areas: Doddaballapura, Tubagere, Nelamangala (Bengaluru Rural); Koratagere (Tumakuru); Sirsi, Puttur, and Belthangady (Western Ghats fringe).
Strategic Role: Sourcing and transshipment corridor for green tender jackfruit (Echor/Kathal) moving into the North Indian wholesale grid (Delhi, Lucknow, Kanpur).

Strategic Role: India's largest volume concentration of industrial tomato paste extraction. The multi-fruit processing plants in this corridor process tomatoes during the winter gluts (January to April) and late monsoon windows, leveraging capacity between the mango and guava processing seasons.
Key Operators: Capricorn Food Products, Jain Farm Fresh Foods, ABC Fruits, Galla Foods (Amara Raja), Paiyur Fruit Products, and contract packaging partners for brands like Kissan (Hindustan Unilever), Maggi (Nestlé), and Del Monte.
Catchment Areas: Madanapalle, Punganur, Kalikiri, Palamaner (Annamayya/Chittoor, AP); Kolar, Mulbagal, Srinivaspur (Karnataka); Hosur, Rayakottai, Palacode (Krishnagiri/Dharmapuri, TN).
Strategic Role: Historical center for domestic ketchup manufacturing and contract processing-grade cultivation.
Catchment Areas: Charotar alluvial basin (Anand, Kheda), Sabarkantha (Himatnagar), Mehsana, and transshipment arrivals from Western Madhya Pradesh (Ratlam, Dhar).
Strategic Role: Pioneer of industrial contract tomato farming for paste extraction (initiated historically by PepsiCo).
Catchment Areas: Jalandhar, Kapurthala, Ludhiana, Patiala, and Sirsa (Haryana).
